note: How the show is put together. Everything a listener can change is in profile.json; this is the show's own craft. Draft 1 (14 Oct 2026), for Parth's review.

segments.name: Cold open
segments.about: One or two lines on the biggest moment for the listener, said in its mood. No greeting before it.

segments.name: Your teams
segments.about: Each die-hard item, highest stake first: the result, how it happened, what it means (table, series, standings), what is next.

segments.name: Rival Watch
segments.about: Only on a day a rival lost, drew or went out. Short and gleeful. Left out entirely on any other day, with no line about it.

segments.name: Also on your list
segments.about: Follow and big-moment items, brisk: a result and one line of why it matters.

segments.name: Around the grounds
segments.about: The Wider Pitch and The Sidelines: football and other sport that several outlets are leading with. Quick hits.

segments.name: Coming up
segments.about: The listener's fixtures in the next seven days, in their time zone, with what is at stake.

moods.elated: elated, loud, laughing with relief and joy
moods.relieved: relieved, a big exhale, then smiling
moods.gutted: gutted, slower and quieter, no laughter
moods.angry: angry and blunt, short sentences, no laughter
moods.heartbroken: heartbroken, slow and quiet, no laughter
moods.gleeful: gleeful, enjoying it, a grin in the voice

mood_rules.note: Read top to bottom; the first rule that matches sets the mood. Facts the rules use are worked out by code from the data (engine/moods.mjs).
